## What this does

Plumbing, not part of the method itself: prints one line to the screen,
flushed immediately. Used for every interactive prompt and progress
message the programs print while running.

```{.rust filename="src/lib.rs" tangle="lib__cout"}
pub fn cout(s: &str) {
    let mut o = io::stdout();
    let _ = o.write_all(s.as_bytes());
    let _ = o.write_all(b"\n");
    let _ = o.flush();
}
```
